QF.id: VI Functions of DP Account Opening_21

question.text: For an illiterate person opening a demat account, what must the DP official do?

answer.text: Read out and explain the account opening form, the Rights and Obligations document, and (where applicable) the delivery instruction form to the client
Ask the person to bring a literate representative
Only obtain a thumb impression without any explanation

explanation.text: The Logic: The DP official must read out and explain the contents of the account opening form, the Rights and Obligations document, and the delivery instruction form to the client, then sign the forms with the remark 'Details explained to the Client(s)'. The Trap: 'Refuse to open the account' would be discriminatory; illiterate persons have every right to open demat accounts. Note: CDSL DPs are not required to read out the delivery instruction form, so that specific step applies primarily to NSDL DPs.
